description: The opened ON.CC report confirms a petition at the county government building over heating failures, but does not quote the residents’ specific demand or establish whether they sought government-policy enforcement rather than relief from the utility. The candidate remains pending_state_target.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous statement from participants or an official account that identifies the demand, government role, and heating provider’s ownership or regulatory status.

description: Inadequate heating and a proposed fee refund do not clearly fit the available demand categories. The candidate has no assigned demand category; the 2016 county rule is search-only and its legal status in February 2021 is unverified.
required_followup: Verify the rule’s text, effective period and application in February 2021, then retain a blank category if no original category fits.

description: The contemporary report says the county announced a two-month heating-fee refund and that repairs restored heating, but it does not verify payment or a direct causal link between the gathering and the announcement. Search-only Hope Voice-derived pages add a mayoral promise and next-day road closure/testing claims that are not independently verified.
required_followup: Locate an original county notice or independent contemporaneous reporting on the refund, repair, and any action on February 6; keep the promise distinct from completion.

description: ON.CC says some residents crossed a police line but does not describe arrests, beatings, crowd dispersal, shootings, killings or protester violence. Search-only copies contain additional physical-contact and force claims with unresolved origin; no such claim is coded.
required_followup: Seek independent event-specific reporting or original footage/transcripts, and leave each response field unknown where evidence remains absent.

description: The opened report’s “over 100” wording supports the 50-person threshold without exact bounds, but no exact headcount, organizer or participant roster is reported. Other search snippets use “hundreds” and are not treated as independent counts.
required_followup: Locate an independent contemporaneous count or organizer account; keep the qualitative threshold evidence if no exact figure is available.

description: The event is reported on February 5, but the end of the gathering and any continuation are unverified. Search-result-only reports mention next-day government actions; no continuation record is created without evidence that the protest itself continued. Adjacent-month press coverage has not been systematically searched.
required_followup: Check independent reports around January 31–February 7 and February 6 onward for event closure, repeated action, or a distinct continuation; do not carry the gathering into March based only on later consequences.

description: The CLB retrospective search result says Chen Guojiang and delivery riders made a small-scale protest over Ele.me holiday bonuses on February 18. The bonus rule appears directed at a private employer; simultaneous attendance, location, executed gathering and a domestic government-policy demand are not established. The rider organization’s membership is not event turnout. The lead remains pending and is not coded as eligible.
required_followup: Only reconsider if a contemporaneous source establishes the gathering, at least 50 participants and a demand to the Chinese government or its policy; otherwise preserve as private-target discovery.

description: Sixteen captured open-web searches covered English/Chinese broad and weekly searches plus farmer/property, homeowner, teacher/health, delivery/driver, retiree and Qing’an heating topics. They yielded one body-verified local gathering and several discovery leads, but do not establish absence elsewhere in China. Chinese local/regional archives and LexisNexis-equivalent searches were not systematically available.
required_followup: Compare with the official baseline and systematically indexed provincial/city newspaper or archive sources in relevant Chinese locales; record any accessible-source gaps.

description: Qing’an secondary copies share unresolved or explicitly credited origin relationships: Hope Voice is credited by 51.ca/SohFrance search results, Epoch Times variants are one publisher/story family, and other copies’ sourcing is unclear. Q015/Q016 did not locate the February 5 county announcement itself; the located official heating rule is a 2016 search-result lead. The official baseline gate and independent review remain pending.
required_followup: Obtain and inspect an original official notice and at least one independent contemporaneous account where possible; compare with the official Mass Mobilization baseline and retain source lineage.
